A file, document, code, image or table the harness produced, with a version.

**Direction:** Harness → Chips  
**Sent by:** a harness  
**Requires a run:** no  
**Schema:** [`artifact.create.json`](/schema/artifact.create.json)

## Fields

Every event also carries the [envelope](/reference/envelope/).

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v` | yes | `1` | Protocol major version. |
| `type` | yes | `"artifact.create"` |  |
| `id` | yes | `string` | The event's own id. Stable across a retry of the same event. |
| `ts` | yes | `string` | When it happened, by Chips' clock. Stamped on the way in; a value the sender writes is replaced. |
| `workspace_id` | yes | `string` | A workspace identifier: `ws_` followed by a ULID. |
| `space_id` | no | `string` | The space, when the event belongs to one. |
| `run_id` | no | `string` | The run, when the event belongs to one. |
| `seq` | no | `number` | Assigned by the server on append, monotonic per workspace. Absent on the way in. |
| `idempotency_key` | no | `string` | Required on every client-originated write. Sending the same key twice is a no-op. |
| `actor` | yes | object | The participant an event is attributed to. |
| `actor.kind` | yes | `"person" \| "harness" \| "agent" \| "system"` | Whether a person, a harness, one of a harness's agents or Chips itself acted. |
| `actor.id` | yes | `string` | The participant id, or `system` for Chips. |
| `actor.harness_id` | no | `string` | For an agent: the harness it speaks through, whose budget and runs are the agent's (ADR 0087). Filled in by Chips. |
| `artifact_id` | yes | `string` | Content-addressed, like every attachment. |
| `kind` | yes | `"file" \| "document" \| "code" \| "image" \| "table"` | How to render it. |
| `title` | yes | `string` | What to call it. |
| `version` | no | `number` | Bumped when the harness revises it. |
| `attachment` | no | object | The bytes, when the artifact is a file. |
| `attachment.attachment_id` | yes | `string` | A attachment identifier: `att_` followed by a ULID. |
| `attachment.filename` | yes | `string` | The name to show. Never trusted for its type. |
| `attachment.mime_type` | yes | `string` | Sniffed from the bytes on upload, not taken from the client. |
| `attachment.byte_size` | yes | `number` | Size in bytes. |
| `attachment.sha256` | yes | `string` | Lowercase hex digest. The store is content-addressed. |
| `attachment.width` | no | `number` | Pixels, for images and video. |
| `attachment.height` | no | `number` | Pixels, for images and video. |
| `attachment.duration_ms` | no | `number` | Milliseconds, for audio and video. |
| `attachment.transcript` | no | `string` | What was said, for a voice note the server transcribed when it arrived (ADR 0054). Machine-heard: the person's words as best the server could make them out. |
| `attachment.replaces` | no | `string` | The version of the room's file of this name that this one was made from (ADR 0099), from the post's `replaces`. Filled in by Chips; a value the sender writes is replaced. |
| `body` | no | `string` | The content, when the artifact is text. |
| `language` | no | `string` | For code, the language to highlight. |

## Example

```json
{
  "v": 1,
  "type": "artifact.create",
  "id": "evt_01K4ZQPX00000000000000006A",
  "ts": "2026-09-02T14:22:06.004Z",
  "workspace_id": "ws_01K4ZQPX000000000000000001",
  "space_id": "spc_01K4ZQPX000000000000000002",
  "actor": {
    "kind": "harness",
    "id": "hrn_01K4ZQPX000000000000000004"
  },
  "run_id": "run_01K4ZQPX000000000000000005",
  "artifact_id": "att_01K4ZQPX00000000000000000C",
  "kind": "document",
  "title": "Northwind confirmation, PO #4471",
  "version": 1,
  "body": "Hi Dana, confirming PO #4471 for 120 units, delivery 19 September."
}
```
